title: Planning an Iftar Menu: Timing, Portions and Service
body_html:
An iftar menu plan should make the first service ready at the agreed time. Balance dishes, portions and replenishment, and verify the local date and prayer time when arranging the event.

For the service options, explore catering services in Dubai. Use this guide to prepare the details for your enquiry.

About this guide

This guide is published by myCHEF, a provider of private chef and catering services. It compares service formats and practical selection criteria. Individual providers should be assessed through their current proposals, relevant documentation and suitability for your occasion.

Plan the first service

Dates, water and soup should be ready before guests need them. Ask how the team works backward from the published prayer time for your date and location, including delivery, setup and checks before service.

Choose a menu and a flow

A family sharing table, buffet and plated meal offer different levels of structure. Mezze, grills, rice dishes and desserts can be combined without making the service feel rushed. Confirm portions, children’s meals and when the main dishes will be served.

Review dietary and practical details

Discuss halal sourcing and any required supplier documentation separately from allergy controls. For a workplace or larger venue, check access, serving space and the time available for clearing. Request a complete proposal for the actual menu and service rather than relying on a generic Ramadan headline price.

Questions to ask before confirming

Request a written menu and scope, confirm the guest count and service hours, and check which staff, equipment and extras are included. Share dietary requirements before approving the menu. Review the payment schedule, change deadlines and cancellation terms, and identify the contact who will coordinate the booking.

Use your completed brief

If iftar catering suits your plans, explore the service details and published options below. Share your date, Dubai location, guest count and preferences so the team can assess availability and prepare a tailored proposal. The written booking confirms the final menu, responsibilities and price.
